name: Aridity (P/PET)
basis: UNEP 1992 World Atlas of Desertification - aridity gradient (semi-arid 0.2-0.5)

name: Rainfall variability (CV)
basis: Nicholson 2017 - East African rainfall is among the world's most variable

name: SPEI drought depth
basis: Vicente-Serrano 2010 SPEI (depth of SPEI-12 < -1; Thornthwaite PET)

name: Growing-season failure frequency
basis: IPC/MUCHALI - failure of the main 4-month season < 80% of normal drives food crises

name: Soil moisture
basis: Additional (MoA) - lower soil moisture = drier; research weight TBD

name: Water levels (% of normal)
basis: Additional (MoW) - reservoir/river levels below normal; research weight TBD

name: Heat-health days (> 90th pct Tmax)
basis: Mora 2017 Nature Clim. Change - days above a deadly-heat threshold (ERA5 Tmax)

name: Flash density
basis: Albrecht 2016 BAMS - NASA LIS/OTD lightning flash density (Lake Victoria basin hotspot)
